level_formula_check: Vanilluxe/Poliwrath/Dewgong offset 1 -> L83, Gastrodon offset 0 -> L82. Confirmed.

attempts.narrative: Snow was live at turn 0 from the Vanilluxe lead (the dossier's fix works). T1 Fake Out flinched Vanilluxe out of its chosen Blizzard, Heat Wave OHKOed it; Gastrodon Protected. T2 Grassy Glide 4x OHKO Gastrodon; Poliwrath Close Combat OHKOed Chi-Yu (my misread: Fighting into Dark). T3 Poliwrath Protected the Grassy Glide, Dewgong Icy Wind dropped both my actives' Speed, Zapdos Tailwind. T4 Thunderbolt KO Poliwrath, Wood Hammer 190 into Fur Coat Dewgong, Muddy Water dropped Rillaboom's accuracy. T5 Grassy Glide + Thunderbolt KO Dewgong.

strategy_checks.check: Snow Warning live before the first attack; Blizzard accurate from turn 1
strategy_checks.evidence: B_WEATHER_SNOW at turn 0; Vanilluxe's native T1 choice was Blizzard (flinched by Fake Out).

strategy_checks.check: Gastrodon Storm Drain / Poliwrath Water Absorb
strategy_checks.evidence: The party used no Water move (crack line honored). Gastrodon's own action was Protect then Earth Power into Chi-Yu (chosen T2, died first).

strategy_checks.check: Dewgong Icy Wind speed control / Encore
strategy_checks.evidence: T3 Icy Wind dropped Rillaboom and Zapdos; Encore never had a repeated target (Tailwind was used once).

protect_ledger.payoff: blocked a lethal Grassy Glide on its entry turn; real

level_changes.reason: won first try with one faint that was my own misread; Gastrodon is the lowest offset and died without attacking
same rule; the snow setter died T1 to one spread Fire

could_this_be_cooler: The lead fix did its job: snow was up from turn 0 and Icy Wind/Muddy Water gave the second wave real texture for a regular. Storm Drain and Water Absorb are both dead against a player who reads the sets (no Water move all fight), which is acceptable for a regular. If one thing changed it would be Vanilluxe holding a Focus Sash instead of Wise Glasses so it survives the obvious Fire lead and Blizzard actually happens once; not applied.
authored_set_legality: No problem found (Dewgong's Ice Beam replacement for Freeze-Dry is legal).
